entities.summary: Stanley Larson Welsh was an American botanist. He worked as professor of integrative biology at Brigham Young University for 47 years and was the founding curator of that university's herbarium, which is named after him. His fields were North American and Tahitian flora, especially the genera Astragalus, Oxytropis and Atriplex. Welsh died on January 30, 2025, at the age of 96.
